card.name: Words before needles, syringes, preservatives
card.fires_on: Small linking or closing words in injection preparation text, right before a device or additive is named, such as needle, syringe, or preservative. Also words like contains and of before an ingredient.

modes.label: Before needle or syringe
modes.description: A closing bracket or size word just before needle, syringe or infusion set in preparation steps.

modes.label: Contains or no preservative
modes.description: The verb contains or contain right before a named additive such as a preservative or benzyl alcohol.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words starting with Mon- and away from compound-type words, with no clear link to the context.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before a needle, syringe or added ingredient is named in injection instructions.
